
```{r}
library(readxl)
library(lubridate)
library(dplyr)

data <- read_excel("Moderna_Pfizer Event Study.xlsx")

data$date <- as.Date(data$`Names Date`)

# Create Excess Returns
data$R_pfe = data$PFE - data$RF
data$R_mrna = data$MRNA - data$RF
```

```{r}
# Training data for Pfizer
pfizer_data <- filter(data, date >= as.Date("2019-01-01") & date <= as.Date("2020-12-03"))

# Make sure Moderna has the equal training sample size
estim_window <- nrow(pfizer_data)
moderna_end <- as.Date("2020-12-10")
moderna_end_row <- which(data$date == moderna_end)
moderna_start_row <- moderna_end_row - estim_window + 1

# Training data for Pfizer Moderna
moderna_data <- data[moderna_start_row:moderna_end_row, ]

# Run CAPM regressions
pfizer_capm <- lm(R_pfe ~ `Mkt-RF`, data=pfizer_data)
moderna_capm <- lm(R_mrna ~ `Mkt-RF`, data = moderna_data)

# Print the regression results
cat("Pfizer CAPM Results:\n")
print(summary(pfizer_capm))
cat("\nModerna CAPM Results:\n")
print(summary(moderna_capm))
```

```{r}
# Define event windows
pfizer_event_start <- as.Date("2020-12-04")
moderna_event_start <- as.Date("2020-12-11")

# Filter event window data
pfizer_event_data <- filter(data, date >= pfizer_event_start)
moderna_event_data <- filter(data, date >= moderna_event_start)

# Calculate predicted returns using CAPM beta coefficients
pfizer_event_data$r_hat <- predict(pfizer_capm, newdata = pfizer_event_data)
moderna_event_data$r_hat <- predict(moderna_capm, newdata = moderna_event_data)

# Calculate abnormal returns
pfizer_event_data$ar <- pfizer_event_data$R_pfe - pfizer_event_data$r_hat
moderna_event_data$ar <- moderna_event_data$R_mrna - moderna_event_data$r_hat

# Print the first 20 AR's
cat("First 20 AR's for Pfizer \n")
pfizer_event_data$ar[1:20]

cat("First 20 AR's for Moderna \n")
moderna_event_data$ar[1:20]
```

```{r}
# Calculate cumulative abnormal returns
pfizer_event_data$car <- cumsum(pfizer_event_data$ar)
moderna_event_data$car <- cumsum(moderna_event_data$ar)

# Days of interest
days_of_interest <- c(5, 10, 15, 20)

# Extract CAR values
pfizer_CAR_values <- pfizer_event_data$car[days_of_interest]
moderna_CAR_values <- moderna_event_data$car[days_of_interest]

# Print the cumulative abnormal returns
cat("Cumulative Abnormal Returns for Pfizer:\n")
cat(sprintf("CAR for %d days: %.3f\n", days_of_interest, pfizer_CAR_values))

cat("\nCumulative Abnormal Returns for Moderna:\n")
cat(sprintf("CAR for %d days: %.3f\n", days_of_interest, moderna_CAR_values))
```
